local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local minusHeld = false

-- GUI

local mainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

local mainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")

-- TITLE
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 28)
title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 8)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "MOVEMENT"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 240)

title.Parent = main

-- SPEED DISPLAY
local speedLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
speedLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 35)
speedLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 35)
speedLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
speedLabel.Text = "16"
speedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

-- SPEED TOGGLE
local speedToggle = Instance.new("TextButton")

	speedToggle,
	plus,

	corner.Parent = button

	main.Visible = not main.Visible

	local character = player.Character

	if not character then
		return nil, nil, nil
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	return character, humanoid, root

	else

		shiftLock.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 50)
	end
end

	speed = math.clamp(
		speed + amount,
		MIN_SPEED,
		MAX_SPEED
	)

	updateUI()
end

plus.Activated:Connect(function()
	changeSpeed(STEP)
end)

minus.Activated:Connect(function()
	changeSpeed(-STEP)
end)

-- HOLD +
plus.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

		plusHeld = true

		task.spawn(function()
			local heldTime = 0

			while plusHeld do
				task.wait(HOLD_INTERVAL)

				if not plusHeld then
					break
				end

				heldTime += HOLD_INTERVAL

				if heldTime >= HOLD_DELAY then
					changeSpeed(HOLD_STEP)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end)

plus.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

		plusHeld = false
	end
end)

-- HOLD -

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

		minusHeld = true

		task.spawn(function()
			local heldTime = 0

			while minusHeld do
				task.wait(HOLD_INTERVAL)

				if not minusHeld then
					break
				end

				heldTime += HOLD_INTERVAL

				if heldTime >= HOLD_DELAY then
					changeSpeed(-HOLD_STEP)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end)

minus.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

		minusHeld = false
	end
end)

-- TOGGLES
speedToggle.Activated:Connect(function()
	speedEnabled = not speedEnabled
	updateUI()
end)

shiftLock.Activated:Connect(function()
	shiftLockEnabled = not shiftLockEnabled
	updateUI()
end)

-- MOVEMENT
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	local character, humanoid, root = getCharacter()

	if not humanoid or not root then
		return
	end

	-- SPEED
	if speedEnabled then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = speed
	else
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
	end

	-- SHIFT LOCK
	if shiftLockEnabled then
		humanoid.AutoRotate = false

		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

		if camera then
			local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
			local flatLook = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)

			if flatLook.Magnitude > 0 then
				root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
					root.Position,
					root.Position + flatLook.Unit
				)
			end
		end
	else
		humanoid.AutoRotate = true
	end

	-- RAMP-STABLE MOVEMENT
	if speedEnabled then
		local direction = humanoid.MoveDirection

		if direction.Magnitude > 0 then

			local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
			rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}

			local rayOrigin = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
			local rayDirection = Vector3.new(0, -7, 0)

			local result = workspace:Raycast(
				rayOrigin,
				rayDirection,
				rayParams
			)

			local moveVelocity

			if result then
				-- Follow the surface of the ramp
				local normal = result.Normal

				local projected =
					direction.Unit
					- normal * direction.Unit:Dot(normal)

				if projected.Magnitude > 0 then
					projected = projected.Unit * speed
				else
					projected = direction.Unit * speed
				end

				moveVelocity = projected
			else
				moveVelocity = direction.Unit * speed
			end

			-- Limit vertical physics so ramps don't launch you
			local verticalVelocity =
				math.clamp(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, -50, 35)

			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
				moveVelocity.X,
				verticalVelocity,
				moveVelocity.Z
			)

		else

			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
				0,
				math.clamp(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, -50, 35),
				0
			)

		end

		-- Stop unwanted spinning
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end
end)

-- RESPAWN
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)

	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	task.wait(0.1)

	if speedEnabled then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = speed
	else
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
	end

	humanoid.AutoRotate = not shiftLockEnabled

	updateUI()
end)

	local popBase = stroke(pop, rgb(225, 225, 232), 2)
	local popStroke = stroke(pop, white, 2)
	local popGrad = make("UIGradient", {Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, 0.5), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.48, 0),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.75, 0.5), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.98, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})}, popStroke)
	local popScale = make("UIScale", {}, pop)
	local svBox = make("Frame", {Size = offset(170, 96), Position = offset(10, 10), BackgroundColor3 = white, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true}, pop)
	local svGrad = make("UIGradient", {}, svBox)
	local darkOverlay = make("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2}, svBox)
	local hueSlider = make("Frame", {Size = offset(170, 20), Position = offset(10, 112), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Active = true}, pop)
	local hueBar = make("Frame", {Size = udim(1, 0, 0, 10), Position = udim(0, 0, 0.5, -5), BackgroundColor3 = white, BorderSizePixel = 0}, hueSlider)
	local previewDot = make("Frame", {Size = offset(24, 24), Position = offset(10, 162), BackgroundColor3 = color, BorderSizePixel = 0}, pop)
	local rgbInput = make("TextBox", {Size = offset(130, 24), Position = offset(50, 162), BackgroundColor3 = rgb(238, 238, 243), BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = cartoon, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = inkCol, PlaceholderText = "255, 0, 0", PlaceholderColor3 = rgb(150, 150, 160), ClearTextOnFocus = false, Text = "255, 0, 0"}, pop)
	local svKnob, hueKnob = makeKnob(svBox, 3, color), makeKnob(hueSlider, 2, color)
	local inputStroke = stroke(rgbInput, lineCol, 1.5)
	local spinTween = TS:Create(popGrad, TweenInfo.new(2, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.In, -1), {Rotation = 360})

	make("UIGradient", {Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1, 0), Rotation = 90}, darkOverlay)
	make("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, rgb(255, 0, 0)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1 / 6, rgb(255, 255, 0)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(2 / 6, rgb(0, 255, 0)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(3 / 6, rgb(0, 255, 255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(4 / 6, rgb(0, 0, 255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(5 / 6, rgb(255, 0, 255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, rgb(255, 0, 0)),
	})}, hueBar)
	corner(swatch, 0, 8)
	stroke(swatch, inkCol, 1.5, 0.6)
	corner(pop, 0, 12)
	corner(svBox, 0, 8)
	corner(darkOverlay, 0, 8)
	corner(hueBar, 1)
	corner(previewDot, 1)
	stroke(previewDot, inkCol, 1, 0.6)
	corner(rgbInput, 0, 8)

	local function paint()
		color = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v)
		swatch.BackgroundColor3 = color
		previewDot.BackgroundColor3 = color
		svKnob.BackgroundColor3 = color
		hueKnob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(h, 1, 1)
		svGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(white, Color3.fromHSV(h, 1, 1))
		popGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, accent), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.48, color), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, accent),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.98, color), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, accent),
		})
		svKnob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(s, 1 - v)
		hueKnob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(h, 0.5)
		rgbInput.Text = string.format("%d, %d, %d", math.round(color.R * 255), math.round(color.G * 255), math.round(color.B * 255))
	end

	local function changed()
		if queued then
			return
		end
		queued = true
		task.defer(function()
			queued = false
			paint()
			onChange(color)
		end)
	end

	for i, c in presetColors do
		local chip = make("TextButton", {Size = offset(16, 16), Position = offset(10 + (i - 1) * 22, 138), BackgroundColor3 = c, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0}, pop)
		corner(chip, 1)
		stroke(chip, inkCol, 1, 0.6)
		chip.Activated:Connect(function()
			h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
			changed()
		end)
	end

	local function idk(i, name)
		if name == "sv" then
			s = math.clamp((i.Position.X - svBox.AbsolutePosition.X) / svBox.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
			v = 1 - math.clamp((i.Position.Y - svBox.AbsolutePosition.Y) / svBox.AbsoluteSize.Y, 0, 1)
		else
			h = math.clamp((i.Position.X - hueSlider.AbsolutePosition.X) / hueSlider.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 0.999)
		end
		changed()
	end

	local function bindSlider(fr, name)
		fr.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
			if not isPress(i) then
				return
			end
			idk(i, name)
			startDrag(i, function(m)
				idk(m, name)
			end)
		end)
	end
	bindSlider(svBox, "sv")
	bindSlider(hueSlider, "hue")

	rgbInput.Focused:Connect(function()
		TS:Create(inputStroke, fast, {Color = accent}):Play()
	end)

	rgbInput.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		TS:Create(inputStroke, fast, {Color = lineCol}):Play()
		local r, g, b = rgbInput.Text:match("(%d+)%D+(%d+)%D+(%d+)")
		if r then
			h, s, v = rgb(math.clamp(tonumber(r), 0, 255), math.clamp(tonumber(g), 0, 255), math.clamp(tonumber(b), 0, 255)):ToHSV()
		end
		changed()
	end)

	local function WHAT(state)
		open = state
		if state then
			for _, p in pickers do
				if p ~= api then
					p.close()
				end
			end
			pop.Visible = true
			popScale.Scale = 0.9
			pop.Position = udim(0.5, 0, 1, -4)
			popStroke.Transparency = 1
			popBase.Transparency = 1
			popGrad.Rotation = 0
			TS:Create(popScale, popTi, {Scale = 1}):Play()
			TS:Create(pop, popTi, {Position = udim(0.5, 0, 1, 6)}):Play()
			TS:Create(popStroke, popTi, {Transparency = 0}):Play()
			TS:Create(popBase, popTi, {Transparency = 0}):Play()
			spinTween:Play()
		else
			pop.Visible = false
			spinTween:Cancel()
		end
	end

	swatch.Activated:Connect(function()
		WHAT(not open)
	end)

	api.close = function()
		WHAT(false)
	end
	table.insert(pickers, api)
	paint()
	return api
end

	local key = (isOn and unOn and 1 or 0) + (isOn and tnOn and 2 or 0)
	if key ~= d.key and (key == 0 or d.hd) then
		if d.bb then
			d.bb:Destroy()

		end
		d.key = key

local function updateLines()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local vs = cam.ViewportSize
	local ax, ay = vs.X / 2, vs.Y
	for _, d in espData do
		local line = d.line
		if line then
			local rt = d.root
			local show = false
			if rt and rt.Parent then
				local p = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(rt.Position)
				if p.Z > 0 then
					show = true
					if d.px ~= p.X or d.py ~= p.Y then
						d.px, d.py = p.X, p.Y
						local dx, dy = p.X - ax, p.Y - ay
						line.Position = offset(ax + dx / 2, ay + dy / 2)
						line.Size = offset(2, math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy))
						line.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx)) - 90
					end
				else
					d.px = nil
				end
			end
			if line.Visible ~= show then
				line.Visible = show
			end
		end
	end
end

local function refresh()
	if isOn then
		if addConn then
			for player in espData do
				sync(player)
			end
		else
			for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
				trackPlayer(player)
			end
			addConn = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(trackPlayer)
			remConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
				dropConns(player)
				clearEsp(player)
			end)
		end
	elseif addConn then
		addConn:Disconnect()
		remConn:Disconnect()
		addConn, remConn = nil, nil
		for player in woahjConns do
			dropConns(player)
		end
		for player in espData do
			clearEsp(player)
		end
	end
	if isOn and tracerOn and not lineConn then
		lineConn = RS.RenderStepped:Connect(updateLines)
	elseif not (isOn and tracerOn) and lineConn then
		lineConn:Disconnect()
		lineConn = nil
	end
end

if _G.AntiBang_Shutdown then
    pcall(_G.AntiBang_Shutdown)
    _G.AntiBang_Shutdown = nil
end

local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
local StarterGui       = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- {{ toggle }}

local CONFIG = {
    ENABLED = true, -- turn anti off or on (use true or false)
}

local NOTIFY = true -- notify if it succeeded (use true or false)

local function getTorso(char)
    if not char then return nil end
    return char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function getRoot(char)
    if not char then return nil end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return (hum and hum.RootPart) or char.PrimaryPart
end

local function notify(title, text)
    if not NOTIFY then return end
    pcall(function()
        StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = title, Text = text, Duration = 3
        })
    end)
end

local function matchesBangFingerprint(plr, myTorso)
    local theirChar = plr.Character
    if not theirChar then return false end

    local theirHRP = theirChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not theirHRP then return false end

    local localOffset = myTorso.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(theirHRP.Position)

    if math.abs(localOffset.X) > 0.25 then return false end
    if math.abs(localOffset.Y) > 0.25 then return false end
    if math.abs(localOffset.Z - 1.1) > 0.25 then return false end

    local dot = theirHRP.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(myTorso.CFrame.LookVector)
    if dot < 0.995 then return false end

    return true
end

local dipBusy = false
local function voidDip()
    if dipBusy then return end
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myChar then return end
    local root = getRoot(myChar)
    if not root or not root.Parent then return end

    dipBusy = true
    local savedCF = root.CFrame
    local savedDH = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight

    workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = -1e9

    local t0 = tick()
    pcall(function()
        while tick() - t0 < 0.15 do
            if not root.Parent then break end
            root.CFrame                  = CFrame.new(0, -800, 0)
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            task.wait()
        end
    end)

    if root.Parent then
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.CFrame                  = savedCF
        local hum = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end
    end

    task.wait()
    workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = savedDH
    dipBusy = false
end

local confirmCount = {}
local lastAction   = 0

local steppedConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if not CONFIG.ENABLED then return end
    if dipBusy then return end

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myChar then return end
    local myTorso = getTorso(myChar)
    if not myTorso then return end

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
            if matchesBangFingerprint(plr, myTorso) then
                confirmCount[plr] = (confirmCount[plr] or 0) + 1

                if confirmCount[plr] >= 5 then
                    confirmCount[plr] = 0

                    if tick() - lastAction < 1.5 then
                        return
                    end
                    lastAction = tick()

                    notify("Anti-Bang", "Bang confirmed from " .. plr.Name)
                    voidDip()
                    return
                end
            else
                confirmCount[plr] = 0
            end
        end
    end
end)

local inputConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then
        CONFIG.ENABLED = not CONFIG.ENABLED
        notify("Anti-Bang", CONFIG.ENABLED and "Enabled" or "Disabled")
    end
end)

local removeConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
    confirmCount[plr] = nil
end)

local charConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    confirmCount = {}
    dipBusy      = false
end)

_G.AntiBang_Shutdown = function()
    steppedConn:Disconnect()
    inputConn:Disconnect()
    removeConn:Disconnect()
    charConn:Disconnect()
end

_G.AntiBang_Toggle = function(state)
    if type(state) == "boolean" then
        CONFIG.ENABLED = state
    else
        CONFIG.ENABLED = not CONFIG.ENABLED
    end
    notify("Anti-Bang", CONFIG.ENABLED and "Enabled" or "Disabled")
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local VoiceChatService = game:GetService("VoiceChatService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- System Configuration
local MAX_HOTBAR = 5 
local clickThreshold = 15 
local SLOT_SIZE = 48 
local SLOT_PADDING = 10 
local INV_SLOT_SIZE = 50 

-- Tool Tracking State
local hotbarList = {}
local inventoryList = {}
local currentSearchText = ""

-- Feature States
local canMoveIcons = false
local canMoveHotbar = false

-- 1. Disable the default Roblox backpack UI
pcall(function() StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, false) end)

-- 2. Create the ScreenGui Container
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "DeltaInventorySystem"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true 
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Forward declaration for UI update & Revert function
local renderUI
local function revertToDefault()
    pcall(function() StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, true) end)
    if screenGui then
        screenGui:Destroy()
    end
end

-- 3. Topbar Container & Icons
local baseOffsetX = 105 
local isVoiceEnabled = false
pcall(function() isVoiceEnabled = VoiceChatService:IsVoiceEnabledForUserIdAsync(player.UserId) end)
if isVoiceEnabled then baseOffsetX = baseOffsetX + 45 end

local topbarContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
topbarContainer.Name = "TopbarContainer"
topbarContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 85, 0, 36)
topbarContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, baseOffsetX, 0, 4)
topbarContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
topbarContainer.Parent = screenGui

local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleBtn.Name = "InventoryToggle"
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 36)
toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
toggleBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
toggleBtn.Text = "🎒"
toggleBtn.TextScaled = true
toggleBtn.Parent = topbarContainer
Instance.new("UICorner", toggleBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local settingsBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
settingsBtn.Name = "SettingsToggle"
settingsBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 36)
settingsBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 45, 0, 0)
settingsBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
settingsBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
settingsBtn.Text = "⚙️"
settingsBtn.TextScaled = true
settingsBtn.Parent = topbarContainer
Instance.new("UICorner", settingsBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local function addStroke(gui)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
    stroke.Thickness = 1.2
    stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    stroke.Parent = gui
end
addStroke(toggleBtn)
addStroke(settingsBtn)

-- 4. Dragging Helper Logic
local function makeDraggable(frame, triggerObjects, conditionFunc)
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos
    for _, obj in ipairs(triggerObjects) do
        obj.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if conditionFunc() and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                dragging = true
                dragStart = input.Position
                startPos = frame.Position
            end
        end)
    end
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
end

-- 5. Settings Panel
local settingsPanel = Instance.new("Frame")
settingsPanel.Name = "SettingsPanel"
settingsPanel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 270)
settingsPanel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -125, 0.4, -135)
settingsPanel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
settingsPanel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
settingsPanel.Visible = false
settingsPanel.Parent = screenGui
Instance.new("UICorner", settingsPanel).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
addStroke(settingsPanel)

local setLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
setLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
setLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
setLayout.Parent = settingsPanel

local setPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
setPadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 15)
setPadding.Parent = settingsPanel

local setLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
setLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
setLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
setLabel.Text = "Inventory Settings"
setLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
setLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
setLabel.TextSize = 18
setLabel.Parent = settingsPanel

local function createToggle(name, text, callback)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 30)
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    frame.Parent = settingsPanel
    
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 1, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = text
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    label.TextSize = 14
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = frame
    
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.8, 0)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0.1, 0)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 50, 50)
    btn.Text = "OFF"
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    btn.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    
    local state = false
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        state = not state
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(50, 150, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 50, 50)
        btn.Text = state and "ON" or "OFF"
        callback(state)
    end)
end

local function createCounter(labelName, getVal, setVal, minVal, maxVal)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 30)
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    frame.Parent = settingsPanel
    
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = labelName
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    label.TextSize = 14
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = frame
    
    local minusBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    minusBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.12, 0, 0.8, 0)
    minusBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 0.1, 0)
    minusBtn.Text = "-"
    minusBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    minusBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    minusBtn.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", minusBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    
    local valLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    valLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.18, 0, 0.8, 0)
    valLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.68, 0, 0.1, 0)
    valLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    valLabel.Text = tostring(getVal())
    valLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    valLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    valLabel.TextSize = 14
    valLabel.Parent = frame

    local plusBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    plusBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.12, 0, 0.8, 0)
    plusBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.87, 0, 0.1, 0)
    plusBtn.Text = "+"
    plusBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    plusBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    plusBtn.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", plusBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

    minusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local current = getVal()
        if current > minVal then
            setVal(current - 1)
            valLabel.Text = tostring(getVal())
            if renderUI then renderUI() end
        end
    end)

    plusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local current = getVal()
        if current < maxVal then
            setVal(current + 1)
            valLabel.Text = tostring(getVal())
            if renderUI then renderUI() end
        end
    end)
end

createCounter("Hotbar Size", function() return SLOT_SIZE end, function(v) SLOT_SIZE = v end, 25, 80)
createCounter("Hotbar Slots", function() return MAX_HOTBAR end, function(v) 
    MAX_HOTBAR = v 
    while #hotbarList > MAX_HOTBAR do
        table.insert(inventoryList, table.remove(hotbarList))
    end
end, 1, 10)

createToggle("IconMover", "Move Icons", function(state) canMoveIcons = state end)
createToggle("HotbarMover", "Move Hotbar", function(state) canMoveHotbar = state end)

-- Revert Button Inside Settings
local revertContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
revertContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 35)
revertContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
revertContainer.Parent = settingsPanel

local revertBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
revertBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
revertBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40)
revertBtn.Text = "REVERT TO DEFAULT"
revertBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
revertBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Code
revertBtn.TextSize = 14
revertBtn.Parent = revertContainer
Instance.new("UICorner", revertBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
addStroke(revertBtn)

revertBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(revertToDefault)

makeDraggable(topbarContainer, {toggleBtn, settingsBtn}, function() return canMoveIcons end)

-- 6. Inventory Container & Search Bar
local invContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
invContainer.Name = "InventoryContainer"
invContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0.5, 0)
invContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0.25, 0)
invContainer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
invContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
invContainer.BorderSizePixel = 0
invContainer.Visible = false
invContainer.Parent = screenGui
Instance.new("UICorner", invContainer).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
addStroke(invContainer)

-- Drop Box with Warning Label
local dropBox = Instance.new("Frame")
dropBox.Name = "DropBox"
dropBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 95, 0, 120)
dropBox.Position = UDim2.new(1, 10, 0, 0)
dropBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40)
dropBox.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
dropBox.Visible = false
dropBox.Parent = invContainer
Instance.new("UICorner", dropBox).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
addStroke(dropBox)

local dropBoxText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
dropBoxText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
dropBoxText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 10)
dropBoxText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
dropBoxText.Text = "DROP"
dropBoxText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
dropBoxText.Font = Enum.Font.Code
dropBoxText.TextSize = 18
dropBoxText.TextScaled = true
dropBoxText.Parent = dropBox

local dropWarning = Instance.new("TextLabel")
dropWarning.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 60)
dropWarning.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 55)
dropWarning.BackgroundTransparency = 1
dropWarning.Text = "This doesnt work in some games"
dropWarning.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
dropWarning.Font = Enum.Font.Code
dropWarning.TextSize = 11
dropWarning.TextWrapped = true
dropWarning.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
dropWarning.Parent = dropBox

-- Toggle DropBox visibility along with inventory
toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() 
    invContainer.Visible = not invContainer.Visible 
    dropBox.Visible = invContainer.Visible
end)
settingsBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() settingsPanel.Visible = not settingsPanel.Visible end)

local searchIcon = Instance.new("TextLabel")
searchIcon.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 35)
searchIcon.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 10)
searchIcon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
searchIcon.Text = "🔎"
searchIcon.TextScaled = true
searchIcon.Parent = invContainer

local searchInput = Instance.new("TextBox")
searchInput.Size = UDim2.new(1, -65, 0, 35)
searchInput.Position = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 10)
searchInput.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
searchInput.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
searchInput.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
searchInput.Text = "" 
searchInput.PlaceholderText = "Search"
searchInput.Font = Enum.Font.Code
searchInput.TextSize = 16
searchInput.ClearTextOnFocus = false
searchInput.Parent = invContainer
Instance.new("UICorner", searchInput).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
addStroke(searchInput)

local invScroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
invScroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -55)
invScroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 55)
invScroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
invScroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
invScroll.ScrollBarThickness = 6
invScroll.Parent = invContainer

local gridLayout = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
gridLayout.CellSize = UDim2.new(0, INV_SLOT_SIZE, 0, INV_SLOT_SIZE) 
gridLayout.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
gridLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
gridLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
gridLayout.Parent = invScroll

local gridPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
gridPadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5)
gridPadding.Parent = invScroll

-- 7. Unified Hotbar Frame
local hotbarFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
hotbarFrame.Name = "HotbarFrame"
hotbarFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0) 
hotbarFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.85, 0) 
hotbarFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
hotbarFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
hotbarFrame.Parent = screenGui
Instance.new("UICorner", hotbarFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
addStroke(hotbarFrame)

local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
listLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
listLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
listLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, SLOT_PADDING) 
listLayout.Parent = hotbarFrame

makeDraggable(hotbarFrame, {hotbarFrame}, function() return canMoveHotbar end)

-- 8. Core Mechanics
local function isInside(pos, guiObject)
    if not guiObject.Visible then return false end
    local tl = guiObject.AbsolutePosition
    local br = tl + guiObject.AbsoluteSize
    return pos.X >= tl.X and pos.X <= br.X and pos.Y >= tl.Y and pos.Y <= br.Y
end

local function triggerDrop(tool)
    if not tool then return end
    tool.CanBeDropped = true
    tool.Parent = workspace
    local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
        local character = player.Character
        local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then
            task.wait()
            handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = (hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 15) + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
        end
    end
end

local function syncTools()
    local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack")
    
    local currentTools = {}
    for _, item in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do if item:IsA("Tool") then currentTools[item] = true end end
    for _, item in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do if item:IsA("Tool") then currentTools[item] = true end end
    
    for i = #hotbarList, 1, -1 do if not currentTools[hotbarList[i]] then table.remove(hotbarList, i) end end
    for i = #inventoryList, 1, -1 do if not currentTools[inventoryList[i]] then table.remove(inventoryList, i) end end
    
    for tool in pairs(currentTools) do
        if not table.find(hotbarList, tool) and not table.find(inventoryList, tool) then
            if #hotbarList < MAX_HOTBAR then
                table.insert(hotbarList, tool)
            else
                table.insert(inventoryList, tool)
            end
        end
    end
end

renderUI = function()
    for _, child in ipairs(invScroll:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end end
    for _, child in ipairs(hotbarFrame:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end end

    local hotbarWidth = (MAX_HOTBAR * SLOT_SIZE) + ((MAX_HOTBAR - 1) * SLOT_PADDING) + 12
    hotbarFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, hotbarWidth, 0, SLOT_SIZE + 10)

    local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

    local function createSlot(tool, parentFrame)
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Name = tool.Name
        btn.Text = tool.Name
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
        btn.Font = Enum.Font.Code
        btn.TextScaled = true
        btn.Parent = parentFrame
        
        local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        corner.Parent = btn
        
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        stroke.Parent = btn

        if parentFrame == hotbarFrame then
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, SLOT_SIZE, 0, SLOT_SIZE)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
            stroke.Thickness = 1
            if tool.Parent == character then
                btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80)
                stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
            else
                stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
            end
        else
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, INV_SLOT_SIZE, 0, INV_SLOT_SIZE)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
            stroke.Thickness = 1.2
            if tool.Parent == character then
                stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
                btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80)
            else
                stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
            end
        end

        local dragging = false
        local dragInput, dragStart, ghostBtn
        local lastClickTick = 0

        btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                dragging = true
                dragInput = input
                dragStart = input.Position
            end
        end)

        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if dragging and input == dragInput then
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                if delta.Magnitude >= clickThreshold then
                    if not ghostBtn then
                        ghostBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
                        ghostBtn.Size = btn.Size
                        ghostBtn.Text = tool.Name
                        ghostBtn.TextScaled = true
                        ghostBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Code
                        ghostBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80)
                        ghostBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
                        ghostBtn.ZIndex = 10
                        ghostBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                        Instance.new("UICorner", ghostBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
                        ghostBtn.Parent = screenGui
                        
                        btn.TextTransparency = 0.8
                        btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.8
                    end

scripts.script:
-- Blox League ball tracer: thin line showing where the ball will go, including bounces.
-- Press + (numpad + or = key) to toggle.
if getgenv().BallTracerCleanup then pcall(getgenv().BallTracerCleanup) end -- remove a previous run
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

local CFG = {
	Enabled = true,
	Color = Color3.fromRGB(130, 205, 255),
	Thickness = 2,
	SimStep = 1 / 40,      -- seconds per drawn segment
	MaxTime = 3,           -- how far ahead to predict
	MaxBounces = 3,
	Gravity = 34,          -- measured from the real ball's flights (world gravity is 196, ball is floaty)
	FloorBounce = 0.65,
	WallBounce = 0.6,
	CornerRadius = 10,     -- radius of the curved floor/wall/ceiling corners
	GoalHalfWidth = 40,    -- rough goal opening, estimated from the goal model
	GoalHeight = 30,
	GoalDepth = 300,
	MinSpeed = 6,          -- hide the line when the ball is basically still
	Window = 0.15,         -- seconds of ball history used to estimate velocity (bigger = steadier, slower to react)
	GroundY = 5.6,         -- ball centre below this = rolling on the floor (no gravity in the speed fit)
	HitThreshold = 8,      -- studs of surprise movement that count as a hit/bounce and reset the estimate
}

local MAX_PTS = math.ceil(CFG.MaxTime / CFG.SimStep) + 2

-- Drawn with GUI frames (the Drawing library does not render on every setup)
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "BallTracer"
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 999
gui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")

local lines = {}
for i = 1, MAX_PTS do
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	f.BorderSizePixel = 0
	f.Visible = false
	f.Parent = gui
	lines[i] = f
end
local conns = {}
getgenv().BallTracerCleanup = function()
	for _, c in ipairs(conns) do c:Disconnect() end
	gui:Destroy()
	getgenv().BallTracerCleanup = nil
end

local function hideFrom(n)
	for i = n, MAX_PTS do lines[i].Visible = false end
end

local function setLine(f, a, b)
	local d = b - a
	local len = d.Magnitude
	f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((a.X + b.X) / 2, (a.Y + b.Y) / 2)
	f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len + 1, CFG.Thickness) -- +1 hides hairline gaps between segments
	f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(d.Y, d.X))
	f.BackgroundColor3 = CFG.Color
	f.Visible = true
end

local BOX = { min = Vector3.new(-205.8, 0, -257), max = Vector3.new(205.8, 103.7, 257) }

-- Ball velocity: the ball is anchored (physics velocity reads 0), so estimate it from position history.
-- Least-squares line through the last CFG.Window seconds after removing gravity's curve, which averages
-- out frame-time noise. A sudden unexpected jump (hit / bounce / reset) clears the history so it reacts fast.
local hist = {}
local vel = Vector3.zero
local base = nil -- smoothed ball position at "now"

local function updateState(ball, now)
	local p = ball.Position
	local grounded = p.Y < CFG.GroundY
	local G = Vector3.new(0, grounded and 0 or -CFG.Gravity, 0)
	local fresh = false
	local last = hist[#hist]
	if last then
		local dt = now - last.t
		if dt <= 0 then return end
		local pred = last.p + vel * dt + G * (0.5 * dt * dt)
		if (p - pred).Magnitude > CFG.HitThreshold or (p - last.p).Magnitude > 60 then
			hist = {}
			fresh = true
		end
	end
	hist[#hist + 1] = { t = now, p = p }
	while #hist > 2 and now - hist[1].t > CFG.Window do table.remove(hist, 1) end

	base = p
	local n = #hist
	if n < 2 or now - hist[1].t < 0.015 then return end

	local sumT, sumP = 0, Vector3.zero
	local pcs = table.create(n)
	local taus = table.create(n)
	for i, h in ipairs(hist) do
		local tau = h.t - now
		local pc = h.p - G * (0.5 * tau * tau) -- remove gravity so the rest is a straight line
		taus[i], pcs[i] = tau, pc
		sumT += tau
		sumP += pc
	end
	local tm, pm = sumT / n, sumP / n
	local sxx, sxy = 0, Vector3.zero
	for i = 1, n do
		local dtau = taus[i] - tm
		sxx += dtau * dtau
		sxy += (pcs[i] - pm) * dtau
	end
	if sxx < 1e-9 then return end
	local newVel = sxy / sxx
	vel = (fresh or n <= 3) and newVel or vel:Lerp(newVel, 0.5)
	base = pm - newVel * tm -- fitted position at "now" (steadier than the raw one)
end

local function project(p)
	local v = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(p)
	return Vector2.new(v.X, v.Y), v.Z
end

local pts = table.create(MAX_PTS)
local function step(now)
	local bodies = workspace:FindFirstChild("Bodies")
	local ball = bodies and bodies:FindFirstChild("Ball")
	if not CFG.Enabled or not ball then
		hideFrom(1)
		hist = {}
		return
	end
	cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	updateState(ball, now)

	local radius = math.max(ball.Size.X, ball.Size.Y, ball.Size.Z) / 2
	local p, v = base or ball.Position, vel
	if v.Magnitude < CFG.MinSpeed then hideFrom(1) return end
	local g = Vector3.new(0, -CFG.Gravity, 0)
	local R = CFG.CornerRadius
	local bounces, count, t = 0, 1, 0
	pts[1] = p

	while t < CFG.MaxTime and count < MAX_PTS do
		local nv = v + g * CFG.SimStep
		local np = p + (v + nv) * 0.5 * CFG.SimStep

		-- The arena has no collidable/queryable parts, so collide with a rounded box:
		-- every edge and corner is a quarter-pipe, so the ball rides up and along walls.
		local bmin, bmax = BOX.min, BOX.max
		if math.abs(np.X) < CFG.GoalHalfWidth and np.Y < CFG.GoalHeight then
			bmin = Vector3.new(bmin.X, bmin.Y, -CFG.GoalDepth)
			bmax = Vector3.new(bmax.X, bmax.Y, CFG.GoalDepth)
		end
		local lo = bmin + Vector3.one * (radius + R)
		local hi = bmax - Vector3.one * (radius + R)
		local q = Vector3.new(math.clamp(np.X, lo.X, hi.X), math.clamp(np.Y, lo.Y, hi.Y), math.clamp(np.Z, lo.Z, hi.Z))
		local d = np - q
		local dist = d.Magnitude
		if dist > R and dist > 1e-6 then
			local n = d / dist
			local vn = nv:Dot(n)
			if vn > 0 then
				np = q + n * R
				local e = CFG.WallBounce + (CFG.FloorBounce - CFG.WallBounce) * math.abs(n.Y)
				nv = nv - n * vn * (1 + e)
				if vn > 15 then bounces += 1 end -- a real impact, not just rolling along the curve
			end
		end

		count += 1
		pts[count] = np
		p, v = np, nv
		t += CFG.SimStep
		if bounces > CFG.MaxBounces then break end
		if v.Magnitude < CFG.MinSpeed and bounces > 0 then break end
	end

	-- project each point once, then draw segments between them (clipping at the camera plane)
	local scr, depth = table.create(count), table.create(count)
	for i = 1, count do scr[i], depth[i] = project(pts[i]) end
	local used = 0
	for i = 1, count - 1 do
		local a2, b2, ad, bd = scr[i], scr[i + 1], depth[i], depth[i + 1]
		if ad > 0 or bd > 0 then
			if ad <= 0 then
				a2 = project(pts[i]:Lerp(pts[i + 1], (0.1 - ad) / (bd - ad)))
			elseif bd <= 0 then
				b2 = project(pts[i]:Lerp(pts[i + 1], (0.1 - ad) / (bd - ad)))
			end
			used += 1
			setLine(lines[used], a2, b2)
		end
	end
	hideFrom(used + 1)
end

table.insert(conns, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	step(os.clock())
end))

table.insert(conns, UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe then return end
	local k = input.KeyCode
	if k == Enum.KeyCode.KeypadPlus or k == Enum.KeyCode.Equals then
		CFG.Enabled = not CFG.Enabled
		print("[Tracer] " .. (CFG.Enabled and "ON" or "OFF"))
	end
end))

getgenv().BallTracerCFG = CFG
print("[Tracer] loaded, press + to toggle")

local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- Настройки
local Settings = {
    AutoFarm = true,
    AutoSwing = true,
    SwingDelay = 0.5,
    TargetRadius = 30,
    ShowESP = true
}

-- Функция для поиска врагов
local function findTargets()
    local targets = {}
    for _, enemy in ipairs(workspace.Enemies:GetChildren()) do
        if enemy:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and enemy.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
            local distance = (enemy.HumanoidRootPart.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
            if distance <= Settings.TargetRadius then
                table.insert(targets, enemy)
            end
        end
    end
    return targets
end

-- Функция атаки
local function attack(target)
    if not target then return end
    
    local sword = character:FindFirstChild("Sword") or character:FindFirstChild("Katana")
    if sword and sword:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
        sword.Handle.CFrame = target.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
        sword:Activate()
    end
end

-- Функция для ESP
local function createESP(enemy)
    if not Settings.ShowESP then return end
    
    local esp = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    esp.Name = "ESP"
    esp.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
    esp.AlwaysOnTop = true
    
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
    label.Text = enemy.Name
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    label.TextSize = 14
    label.Parent = esp
    
    esp.Parent = enemy.Character or enemy
end

    while true do
        if Settings.AutoFarm then
            local targets = findTargets()
            if #targets > 0 then
                local nearest = targets[1]
                local minDist = math.huge
                
                for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
                    local dist = (target.HumanoidRootPart.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist < minDist then
                        minDist = dist
                        nearest = target
                    end
                end
                
                if nearest then
                    attack(nearest)
                end
            end
        end
        
        wait(Settings.SwingDelay)
    end
end)

toggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Settings.AutoFarm = not Settings.AutoFarm

    toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Settings.AutoFarm and Color3.new(0, 1, 0) or Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
end)

-- Создание ESP для существующих врагов
